dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:7001.text: A river rising in 宛陵, 丹陽, and flowing northwest into the 江. From 水, with 令 as phonetic.

shuowen:7002.text: A river in 丹陽. From 水, with 箄 as phonetic.

shuowen:7003.text: A river rising in 溧陽 county, 丹陽. From 水, with 栗 as phonetic.

shuowen:7004.text: A river rising at Mount 陽海 in 零陵 and flowing north into the 江. From 水, with 相 as phonetic.

shuowen:7005.text: The 汨羅 deep in 長沙: the water in which Qu Yuan drowned himself. From 水, with abbreviated 冥 as phonetic.

shuowen:7006.text: A river rising in 臨武, 桂陽, and entering the 匯. From 水, with 秦 as phonetic.

shuowen:7007.text: A river rising in 南平, 桂陽, and flowing west into 營道. From 水, with 罙 as phonetic.

shuowen:7008.text: A river rising at Mount 玉 in 鐔成, 武陵, and flowing east into 鬱林. From 水, with 覃 as phonetic.

shuowen:7009.text: A river rising west of 孱陵, 武陵, and flowing southeast into the 江. From 水, with 由 as phonetic.

shuowen:7010.text: A river rising in 艾 county, 豫章, and flowing west into the 湘. From 水, with 買 as phonetic.

shuowen:7011.text: A river rising in 龍川, 南海, and flowing west into the 溱. From 水, with 貞 as phonetic.

shuowen:7012.text: A river rising in 鬱林 commandery. From 水, with 畱 as phonetic.

shuowen:7013.text: A river rising in Mi county, Henan, and flowing east into the 潁. From 水, with 翼 as phonetic.

shuowen:7014.text: A river rising in 舞陽, 南陽, and flowing east into the 潁. From 水, with 無 as phonetic.

shuowen:7015.text: A river rising in 魯陽, 南陽, and entering 城父. From 水, with 敖 as phonetic.

shuowen:7016.text: A river rising at Mount 中陽 in 舞陽, 南陽, and entering the 潁. From 水, with 親 as phonetic.

shuowen:7017.text: A river rising at Mount 桐柏大復 in 平氏, 南陽, and flowing southeast into the sea. From 水, with 隹 as phonetic.

shuowen:7018.text: A river rising at Mount 堯 in 魯陽, 南陽, and flowing northeast into the 汝. From 水, with 蚩 as phonetic.

shuowen:7019.text: A river rising at Mount 衡 in 雉, 南陽, and flowing east into the 汝. From 水, with 豊 as phonetic.

shuowen:7020.text: A river rising in 蔡陽, 南陽, and flowing east into the 夏 water. From 水, with 員 as phonetic.

shuowen:7021.text: A river rising at Mount 垂 in 弋陽, 汝南, and flowing east into the 淮. From 水, with 𢌿 as phonetic.

shuowen:7022.text: A river rising in 黑閭 ravine, 上蔡, 汝南, and entering the 汝. From 水, with 意 as phonetic.

shuowen:7023.text: A river rising in 新郪, 汝南, and entering the 潁. From 水, with 囟 as phonetic.

shuowen:7024.text: A river rising in 吳房, 汝南, and entering the 瀙. From 水, with 瞿 as phonetic.

shuowen:7025.text: A river rising at Mount 乾 in 陽城, 潁川, and flowing east into the 淮; a major watercourse of 豫州. From 水, with 頃 as phonetic.

shuowen:7026.text: A river rising in the mountains of 陽城, 潁川, and flowing southeast into the 潁. From 水, with 有 as phonetic.

shuowen:7027.text: A river rising at Mount 少室 in 陽城, 潁川, and flowing east into the 潁. From 水, with 㥯 as phonetic.

shuowen:7028.text: A river receiving the 浪湯 canal at 扶溝, 淮陽, and flowing east into the 淮. From 水, with 過 as phonetic.

shuowen:7029.text: A river receiving the 洵波 at 博安, 九江, and flowing north into the 氐. From 水, with 丗 as phonetic.

shuowen:7030.text: A river receiving the 陰 ditch at 浚儀, 陳畱; at 蒙 it becomes the 雝 water and flows east into the 泗. From 水, with 反 as phonetic.

shuowen:7031.text: A river rising in the state of Zheng. From 水, with 曾 as phonetic. The Odes says: 'The 潧 and 洧 are flowing in full spate.'

shuowen:7032.text: A river in 臨淮. From 水, with 夌 as phonetic.

shuowen:7033.text: A river rising in 濮陽, 東郡, and flowing south into 鉅野. From 水, with 僕 as phonetic.

shuowen:7034.text: A river between Qi and Lu. From 水, with 樂 as phonetic. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'The duke met the marquis of Qi at the 濼.'

shuowen:7035.text: A river in Lu. From 水, with 郭 as phonetic.

shuowen:7036.text: The moat at Lu's northern city gate. From 水, with 爭 as phonetic.

shuowen:7037.text: A river rising in 東武陽, 東郡, and entering the sea. From 水, with 㬎 as phonetic. Sang Qin says it rises in 高唐, 平原.

shuowen:7038.text: A river rising in 平樂, 山陽, and flowing northeast into the 泗. From 水, with 包 as phonetic.

shuowen:7039.text: The waters of 菏澤, in 胡陵, 山陽. The Tribute of Yu says: 'Float along the 淮 and 泗, reaching the 菏.' From 水, with 苛 as phonetic.

shuowen:7040.text: It receives the 泲 water and flows east into the 淮. From 水, with 四 as phonetic.

shuowen:7041.text: A river between Qi and Lu. From 水, with 亘 as phonetic.

shuowen:7042.text: The 河灉 river, in Song. From 水, with 雝 as phonetic.

shuowen:7043.text: The 澶淵 water, in Song. From 水, with 亶 as phonetic.

shuowen:7044.text: A river rising at Mount 臨樂 in 蓋, 泰山, and flowing north into the 泗. From 水, with 朱 as phonetic.

shuowen:7045.text: A river; the source calls it a major watercourse of 青州. From 水, with 术 as phonetic.

shuowen:7046.text: A river rising east of 費, 東海, and flowing west into the 泗. From 水, with 斤 as phonetic. Another account says the 沂 rises in 蓋, 泰山, and is a major watercourse of 青州.

shuowen:7047.text: A river rising at Mount 高 in 臨朐, Qi, and flowing northeast into 鉅定. From 水, with 羊 as phonetic.

shuowen:7048.text: A river rising at Mount 厲嬀 in Qi commandery and flowing northeast into 鉅定. From 水, with 蜀 as phonetic.

shuowen:7049.text: A river rising at Mount 覆甑 in 桑瀆, 東海, and flowing northeast into the sea. Alternatively, to pour or irrigate. From 水, with 旣 as phonetic.

shuowen:7050.text: A river rising at Mount 箕屋 in 琅邪 and flowing east into the sea; a major watercourse of 徐州. The Book of Xia says: 'The 濰 and 淄 follow their courses.' From 水, with 維 as phonetic.

shuowen:7051.text: A river rising at Mount 壺 in 靈門, 琅邪, and flowing northeast into the 濰. From 水, with 吾 as phonetic.

shuowen:7052.text: A river rising at Mount 東泰 in 朱虛, 琅邪, and flowing east into the 濰. From 水, with 文 as phonetic. Sang Qin says the 汶 rises in 萊蕪, 泰山, and flows southwest into the 泲.

shuowen:7053.text: A river rising at Mount 陽丘 in 曲城, 東萊, and flowing south into the sea. From 水, with 台 as phonetic.

shuowen:7054.text: A river rising in 武安, 魏郡, and flowing northeast into the 呼沱 water. From 水, with 𡩠 as phonetic. 𡩠 is the large-seal form of 𡪢.

shuowen:7055.text: A river rising in the western mountains of 襄國, Zhao, and flowing northeast into the 寖. From 水, with 禺 as phonetic.

shuowen:7056.text: A river rising in 襄國, Zhao, and flowing east into the 湡. From 水, with 虒 as phonetic.

shuowen:7057.text: A river at Mount 逢 in 中丘, 常山, flowing east into the 湡. From 水, with 者 as phonetic. The Erya says: 'A small islet is called 渚.'

shuowen:7058.text: A river rising at 井陘 in 石邑, 常山, and flowing southeast into the 泜. From 水, with 交 as phonetic. There is a 洨 county in 𨙶 state.

shuowen:7059.text: A river rising at Mount 贊皇 in 房子, 常山, and flowing east into the 泜. From 水, with 齊 as phonetic.

shuowen:7060.text: A river in 常山. From 水, with 氐 as phonetic.

shuowen:7061.text: A river rising in 故安, 涿 commandery, and flowing east into the 漆涑. From 水, with 需 as phonetic.

shuowen:7062.text: A river rising in 浚靡, 右北平, and flowing southeast into the 庚. From 水, with 壘 as phonetic.

shuowen:7063.text: A river rising beyond the frontier of 漁陽 and flowing east into the sea. From 水, with 古 as phonetic.

shuowen:7064.text: A river rising beyond the frontier of 番汗, 遼東, and flowing southwest into the sea. From 水, with 巿 as phonetic.

shuowen:7065.text: A river rising in 鏤方, 樂浪, and flowing east into the sea. From 水, with 貝 as phonetic. Another account says it rises in 浿水 county.

shuowen:7066.text: A northern river. From 水, with 褱 as phonetic.

shuowen:7067.text: A river rising at Mount 累頭 in 陰館, 鴈門, and flowing east into the sea. Some say it is the 治 river. From 水, with 纍 as phonetic.

shuowen:7068.text: A river rising west of 直路, 北地, and flowing east into the 洛. From 水, with 虘 as phonetic.

shuowen:7069.text: A river beginning at Mount 戍夫 in 葰人, 雁門, and flowing northeast into the sea. From 水, with 瓜 as phonetic.

shuowen:7070.text: A river beginning in 靈丘, 北地, and flowing east into the 河. From 水, with 寇 as phonetic. The 滱 is the 漚夷 water, a river of 并州.

shuowen:7071.text: A river beginning in 廣昌, 北地, and flowing east into the 河; a major watercourse of 幷州. From 水, with 來 as phonetic.

shuowen:7072.text: A river rising among the northern Man of 郁郅, 北地. From 水, with 尼 as phonetic.

shuowen:7073.text: A river northeast of 美稷𠈃 in 西河, apparently. From 水, with 南 as phonetic.

shuowen:7074.text: A river rising at 北沙 in 中陽, 西河, and flowing south into the 河. From 水, with 焉 as phonetic.

shuowen:7075.text: A ferry on the 河, west of 西河. From 水, with 𡍮 as phonetic.

shuowen:7076.text: A river. From 水, with 旟 as phonetic.

shuowen:7077.text: To cross through water. From 水, with 旬 as phonetic.

shuowen:7078.text: A river rising at Mount 北嚻 and entering 邙澤. From 水, with 舍 as phonetic.

shuowen:7079.text: A river. From 水, with 刃 as phonetic.

shuowen:7080.text: A river. From 水, with 直 as phonetic.

shuowen:7081.text: A river. From 水, with 妾 as phonetic.

shuowen:7082.text: A river. From 水, with 居 as phonetic.

shuowen:7083.text: A river. From 水, with 臮 as phonetic.

shuowen:7084.text: A river. From 水, with 尤 as phonetic.

shuowen:7085.text: A river. From 水, with 因 as phonetic.

shuowen:7086.text: A river. From 水, with 果 as phonetic.

shuowen:7087.text: A river. From 水, with 𧴪 as phonetic. Read like 瑣.

shuowen:7088.text: A river. From 水, with 尨 as phonetic.

shuowen:7089.text: A river. From 水, with 乳 as phonetic.

shuowen:7090.text: A river. From 水, with 夂 as phonetic. 夂 is ancient-script 終.

shuowen:7091.text: Shallow water. From 水, with 百 as phonetic.

shuowen:7092.text: A river. From 水, with 千 as phonetic.

shuowen:7093.text: A river. From 水, with 𦣞 as phonetic. The Odes says: 'The 江 has 洍.'

shuowen:7094.text: 郣澥 is an arm of the sea. From 水, with 解 as phonetic. Another explanation: 澥 is precisely 澥谷.

shuowen:7095.text: The northern drifting sands. Alternatively, clear. From 水, with 莫 as phonetic.

shuowen:7096.text: Heaven's pool, which receives the hundred rivers. From 水, with 每 as phonetic.

shuowen:7097.text: Great. From 水, with 尃 as phonetic.

shuowen:7098.text: Water arriving in great volume. From 水, with 闇 as phonetic.

shuowen:7099.text: Floodwaters. From 水, with 共 as phonetic.

shuowen:7100.text: Water that does not follow its course. Alternatively, to descend. From 水, with 夅 as phonetic.
